affected_subject.reason: Identifies DynamicSwapFeeModule.getFee() and CLFactory.getSwapFee() with their fee caps.

trigger_or_action.reason: A dynamically calculated fee above 100,000 is rejected by CLFactory.getSwapFee().

direct_effect.reason: Fee above 10% is rejected and system falls back to default tick spacing fee, losing discounts and anti-MEV cap.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Conflicting caps (500,000 vs 100,000) establish expected-vs-actual mismatch; mitigation states aligning thresholds.

summary: Report identifies the affected fee functions, the trigger of a fee above 10%, the fallback effect, and the conflicting cap relationship supporting a safety mismatch.
